title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ServiceCategory
description: The (service) category resource is used to group service candidates in logical containers. Categories can contain other categories. (TM Forum TMF633 Service Catalog Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition ServiceCategory; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceCategory:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ServiceCategory'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceCategory:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of the category

isRoot.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/isRoot'. If true, this Boolean indicates that the category is a root of categories

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status

parentId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/parentId'. Unique identifier of the parent category

category.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/category'. List of child categories in the tree for in this category. In TMF this is an array of ServiceCategoryRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced ServiceCategory entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceCategory:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

serviceCandidate.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/serviceCandidate'. List of service candidates associated with this category. In TMF this is an array of ServiceCandidateRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced ServiceCandidate entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceCandidate:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/validFor'. The period for which the category is valid

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCategory/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'ServiceCategory' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format. If you define a start, you must also define an end
